description: A delicious 3-day food trip to Tokyo, exploring street food, local markets, and hands-on cooking experiences.

accommodation.amenities: restaurant, spa, pool, airport shuttle, breakfast included

days.title: Arrival and Ginza Street Food Exploration
days.description: Arrive in Tokyo, check into your hotel, and immediately dive into the city's vibrant street food scene in Ginza.

activities.notes: What you'll see: You'll explore the bustling streets of Ginza, known for its upscale shops and diverse culinary offerings.What to bring: Wear comfortable shoes as you'll be walking a fair bit.What to eat: Expect to sample a variety of local street foods and snacks.Good to know: This tour is a great introduction to Tokyo's food culture.

days.title: Cooking Class and Shibuya Night Market
days.description: Spend the day learning to cook Japanese dishes with a local chef, then experience the lively Shibuya night market.

activities.activity_name: Tokyo Cooking Class with Local Chef — Afternoon Edition
activities.notes: What you'll see: You'll learn traditional Japanese cooking techniques in a hands-on environment.What to bring: An appetite and a willingness to learn new culinary skills.What to eat: You'll get to enjoy the dishes you prepare during the class.Good to know: This is a fantastic way to immerse yourself in Japanese cuisine.

activities.activity_name: Tokyo Night Market & Tapas Crawl — Evening Edition
activities.notes: What you'll see: Experience the vibrant atmosphere of a Tokyo night market and various tapas bars.What to bring: Your wallet for additional purchases and an open mind for new flavors.What to eat: A wide array of small dishes and local snacks will be available.Good to know: This tour is perfect for experiencing Tokyo's nightlife and diverse food scene.

days.title: Ueno Cooking Experience and Departure
days.description: Enjoy a final cooking class in Ueno before heading to the airport for your departure.

activities.activity_name: Tokyo Cooking Class with Local Chef
activities.notes: What you'll see: You'll learn to prepare authentic Japanese dishes under the guidance of a local chef.What to bring: Comfortable clothing and a desire to learn about Japanese culinary traditions.What to eat: You will enjoy the meal you prepare during the class.Good to know: This is a great opportunity to take home some new cooking skills.
